changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Persist idempotent offboarding completion and its durable event marker.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_separation_due_offboarding ON "${schema}".separation (tenant_id, last_working_date, id) WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND offboarded_at IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE "${schema}".separation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_separation_offboarding_marker CHECK ( (offboarded_at IS NULL AND offboarding_event_id IS NULL) OR (offboarded_at IS NOT NULL AND offboarding_event_id IS NOT NULL) );

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".separation DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_separation_offboarding_marker; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "${schema}".idx_separation_due_offboarding;

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Normalize historical timesheet hours and enforce the public two-decimal contract.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE "${schema}".timesheet_entry SET hours_worked = ROUND(hours_worked, 2), updated_at = NOW() WHERE hours_worked <> ROUND(hours_worked, 2);
ALTER TABLE "${schema}".timesheet_entry ADD CONSTRAINT ck_timesheet_hours_two_decimals CHECK (hours_worked = ROUND(hours_worked, 2));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".timesheet_entry DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_timesheet_hours_two_decimals;
